findingDetails.title: Refusal guard re-hard-codes the loop-type set a constant owns, on an always-true predicate
findingDetails.case: A maintainer adds a third active fan-out loop type to ACTIVE_FANOUT_LOOP_TYPES at :475 and the new refusal silently does not cover it, because the guard compares against a hand-written pair instead of the constant.
findingDetails.evidence: Guard at :3400-3402 tests (loopType === 'research' || loopType === 'review') after assertActiveFanoutLoopType(loopType) already threw for any other value at :3306; the pair is owned by ACTIVE_FANOUT_LOOP_TYPES at :475 and consumed at :478-481. Identical literal shape already ships at the sibling guard :3408.
findingDetails.findingClass: naming and single-source-of-truth drift in a guard predicate
findingDetails.scopeProof: Constant :475, assertion :3306, new guard :3400-3402 and sibling guard :3408 read in place in one file; no cross-file claim.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If the :3408 sibling idiom is ever hoisted to the constant, this becomes duplication rather than precedent-following.

findingDetails.title: One authoring-card instruction hand-duplicated across two scaffold branches, plus a third variant elsewhere
findingDetails.case: The card file is renamed; a maintainer updates the Gate-3 notice and one create.sh echo, and the phase-parent scaffold keeps naming a path that no longer exists until a test run catches it.
findingDetails.evidence: Byte-identical echo sentence at create.sh:2207 (level flow) and :2416 (phase-parent flow), differing only in indentation; spec-gate-core.mjs:178 carries a third differently-worded instruction naming the same spec-authoring-card.md. scaffold-passes-its-own-gate.vitest.ts asserts the path in both flows, so drift is caught by a run.
findingDetails.findingClass: duplicated literal with a single upstream owner
findingDetails.scopeProof: Both create.sh occurrences located by direct search of that file; spec-gate-core.mjs:178 is the added hunk from this change set; ROUTER.md rows :37,39,46,57 checked as the path's other carriers.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If the two branches become one shared function, the duplication disappears and the finding closes.
